text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated websocket disconnects (502/504) observed for tenant 'starkbank' on VPC-gw-prod-us-east dedicated pool. Error spike started ~2051112140. Automatic retries increase detected. Paging oncall.

sarah (oncall): Acked. I'm on it. tagging @miguel and @julia. Can someone grab customer contact? @kevin?

kevin (customer-success): I have StarkBank eng on the line (starkbank-infra). They report streaming sessions drop after ~15-20s and client reconnect loops. They've throttled retries but still seeing user-facing failures. I'll add them to the channel.

starkbank-infra: hey, thanks for the quick response. logs: "ws disconnected: read timeout after 18s" repeating. client side shows immediate reconnect with no backoff, causing ~10k/sec reconnects. this started after our deploy 30m ago.

sarah (oncall): Thanks. Miguel — can runtime confirm if dedicated pool nodes are healthy? Any OOMs / CGPs / network flaps?

miguel (eng-runtime): Looking. `kubectl get pods -n redwood-dedicated-starkbank` shows pods Ready=3/3 but `kubectl logs` shows repeated `accept: connection reset by peer` and `kvcache miss + rebuild` spam. No OOMs. Network metrics show spike in retransmits on eni-attach to gw-proxy.

julia (eng-platform): Noted. Gateway logs (vpc-gw) show `upstream read timeout` between our proxy and customer backend (their app gateway). Timeouts cluster at ~18s. We typically have 30s read timeout; config shows 15s inherited from customer's proxy chain. Could be client-side keepalive missing.

sarah (oncall): So chain: StarkBank frontend -> their app gateway -> our VPC gateway -> runtime. Timeouts are happening between their app gateway and our VPC gateway.

starkbank-infra: Correct. Their gateway change may have reduced keepalive. We can flip a feature flag client-side but that requires their deploy. Can you allow a temporary tweak on your end to extend timeouts while they fix? Would be fastest.

miguel (eng-runtime): We can temporarily increase websocket idle/read timeout on vpc-gw for that tenant to 60s and enable `disable_connection_reuse=false` to keep long-lived sockets. I can deploy a canary change to the dedicated pool. Needs platform approval for per-tenant config change.

julia (eng-platform): Approving per-tenant config change as emergency mitigation. Steps: 1) add `starkbank.timeout_override=60s` into vpc-gw config; 2) roll config to 1 node as canary; 3) monitor. Miguel, can you prepare the patch? I will coordinate with infra.

miguel (eng-runtime): Pushing patch now. CI green. Rolling to node-1 of dedicated pool: `kubectl apply -f vpc-gw-starkbank-override.yaml` -> canary

sarah (oncall): @kevin please tell customer we are deploying a temporary timeout bump; ask them to hold client deploy for 30m.

kevin (customer-success): Told them. They agreed to pause their deploy. They're standing by.

incident-bot: Deploy event: vpc-gw config rollout started by miguel at 2051112380. Canary node-1 updated.

miguel (eng-runtime): Canary shows immediate improvement: disconnects drop ~85% in last 3 minutes. No increase in memory or CPU. I'm rolling the rest of nodes now.

julia (eng-platform): While rolling, enable temporary request rate-limit for that tenant at the gateway to limit reconnect storms: `limit_req zone=starkbank burst=200 nodelay` — propose 10k/s -> 2k/s sustained. Miguel ok to apply?

miguel (eng-runtime): Applied rate-limit. Logs show reconnect attempts queued and smoothed; backend latency stable.

starkbank-infra: Seeing stabilisation on our side; client reconnect loops reduced, user sessions resuming. Huge improvement. Thanks.

sarah (oncall): Good. Next: we need a mitigation runbook and long-term fix. Immediate actions taken: timeout override to 60s, gateway per-tenant rate-limit, canary + full rollout, asked customer to pause deploy. Impact: partial service degradation for users using streaming endpoints; estimated customer-facing error rate peaked at 12% and down to <0.5% now.

ops-manager: Paging followup — create incident ticket and schedule 1h postmortem with customer. Also CC security if any auth retries observed.

kevin (customer-success): Filed INC-205111 with customer logs attached and their Kyndryl ticket #SB-4122. They've requested a joint RCA.

miguel (eng-runtime): I'll run additional validation for connection reuse and KV cache warmups. Also plan: add a guard in vpc-gw to respect upstream keepalive headers and not inherit a too-short timeout. File follow-up task: REQ-rt-942.

julia (eng-platform): I'll add a platform check to detect sudden reductions in max-open-sockets per-tenant and alert before reach critical. Ticket PLAT-777.

sarah (oncall): Handoff: I'm going offline in ~20m. @miguel you'll be primary oncall for further signs; @julia owns platform follow-ups; @kevin owns customer comms. If anything regresses escalate to ops-manager.

starkbank-infra: Thanks everyone. We'll push a safe keepalive fix in next deploy window and confirm once live. Appreciate the quick mitigation.

sarah (oncall): Closing active paging now. If there are no further errors in 30m we'll mark resolved and start RCA. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: status=mitigated, mitigation=timeout_override+rate_limit+canary_rollout, severity=high, affected_tenant=starkbank, incident_id=INC-205111, created=2051112140, mitigated=2051112480.

sarah (oncall): Postmortem TODOs: 1) add automated per-tenant timeout override rollback guard, 2) docs for customer retries/backoff guidance, 3) RCA call with StarkBank next Tue. I'll draft and assign.

starkbank-infra: We'll add our logs to the RCA. Thanks again.
